messages:
sam: quick note: onboarding run for aries-32k-int8 showed a tiny punctuation change after KV handoff. Fails strict goldset EM.
lucy: short repro?
sam: prefilling ~21k tokens, then trigger shard handoff; after resume token at pos 21012 becomes ";" -> "; " (extra space). Minimal curl: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Model: aries-32k-int8" -d '{"input":"<seed 21k>"}' https://qa.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
hao: is this only int8? int4/fp16?
sam: int8 repros ~30% on qa-dedicated, int4 much lower, fp16 absent so far.
lucy: try DISABLE_PREFIX_CACHE=1 and ROTARY_REMAP=1 flags?
sam: disabling prefix cache greatly reduces rate. ROTARY_REMAP reduces but doesn't remove. runtime log: ```
[2025-03-04T11:02:03Z] INFO kvcache: resume shard=3 span=20992-21248 checksum=0x9c4f2e
[2025-03-04T11:02:03Z] WARN token-compare pos=21012 expected=";" got="; "
```
hao: sounds like boundary/rounding at write time. I'll run chunk-size sweep 512/1024/2048 + 5 seeds and dump kvcache checksums.
lucy: if hao confirms, mitigation idea: handshake metadata check (hash of rotary indices + checksum) on resume and fall back to re-prefill on mismatch. Lower perf but safe.
dev-bot: ci: canary build aries-32k-int8-20250304 queued on qa.
sam: created ticket INF-4502 and pushed seed + tiny goldset to repo. assigning hao.
lucy: thanks all, keep it high priority for model bring-up.
